reviews.title: Wow. What a value.
reviews.comment: Day one review. Subject to revision. This monitor rips. It looks crisp. The 4k pops in HDR and the refresh is handling everything ive thrown at it with my PS5 Pro. Time will tell if this monitor holds up but i am pleasantly pleased with the build quality. The UI and the easy to use settings. Did i mention that this monitor rips?? Rips meaning shes fast. So far ive run Cyberpunk 2077 (4k at 120hz-wowsa) Ive run Forza 5. ZERO LATENCY. I play with a wheel and the throttle pedal is instant. This was the main reason i purchased a gaming montior. My 4k 60hz could not keep up with these titles and i wanted the FPS. Day one and it's 5 stars top to bottom for me. I will 100% come back and revise this review if anything happens to change my opinion. I also connected a sound bar to this. Through the aux out. Sound syncing is spot on. I dont know if i could have found a better monitor with these specs at this price. If youre in the market for a budget curved 4k 165hz monitor,  this is it.
reviews.author: Robert Dennis

reviews.title: Top Brand Performance at a budget price
reviews.comment: I was in the market for a 32 inch 4K monitor with a bright sharp display. I tried a VA panel and found the text slightly blurry and colors washed out. I am running Win10 and Linux Mint and both are beautiful. Not sure if it is the IPS technology in this model, but this is a much better monitor. It has all the needed inputs like HDMI, DP, and even has a speaker. One thing to be aware of, the stand is very wide, so you need a big desk or shelf. The OSD menu is fairly easy to understand. I was hesitant to buy from an unknown brand like ZZA. But they seem to build great products. Very happy with my purchase. Amazon delivered it in one day. Thanks Amazon.
reviews.author: music_collector

reviews.title: OK, but know the limitations-no remote, sound, not very high or tall monitor.
reviews.comment: No remote; have to get up and use funky controls on back of monitor to switch devices should I want to connect anything else up - not convenient, so nothing connected except my PC. Colors seem fine overall but swirly lights on back of monitor sometimes work sometimes not; strange noises come from  this monitor like trapped critters inside. Overall this curved 49+ inch monitor is like two and a half 27" monitors put together; I wish the monitor was higher, width is nice but the monitor just seems to narrow from top to bottom to be truly 5 star worthy. Disappointing for a $500 monitor - my flat 55" 4K TCL television that I also have connected to my PC is much more enjoyable to watch and easier to read from a distance. The ZZA is just OK for true wide screen movies to watch in the background while I work mostly on my 55" flat screen. And no, this monitor has no built in sound which I knew going in, I use my PreSonus monitors as normal so it didn't concern me.
reviews.author: Jason Bourne

reviews.title: Good for the price.
reviews.comment: It's really impressive for the price (140 USD when I night it, 165 is a little steep in my opinion). As others have mentioned it does indeed only go up to 144,Hz in 2560x1440 resolution, but that's not really a huge deal considering the value. The picture is decent, much better than I was expecting at the price point, but doesn't compete with high end competitors (wasn't expecting it to). Interestingly, despite the refresh rate only being 144Hz compared to the advertised 165Hz, resolution can seemingly go up to 4k, which was surprising, that's why I gave it the 5 star to make up for the Hz mislead.
reviews.author: The Thinking Pig

reviews.title: False Advertising??
reviews.comment: I bought this monitor because there was essentially no bezel on 3 sides. I was excited when the monitor arrived. When I hooked it up however, I found that there was a 1/4" black border on the 3 sides that were supposed to be essentially bezel-less. I tried new cables, I tried scaling and different resolutions with my Mac, I tried searching the menu on the monitor its self to see if there was a setting but there wasn't. I tried to look up the ZZA website for a firmware update but apparently it doesn't exist. I can't contact their customer support because it apparently doesn't exist either. Other than that issue, the picture that I do have is good. the colors are good and the lines and text are crisp. But because the picture doesn't go edge to edge like advertised, I have to give it a 1 star. I really wish these companies cared more about their customers.
reviews.author: Malcolm Phoenix
